# Digital Experience Monitoring

Monitor device, network, and application health across your Zero Trust organization

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Digital experience](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/index.md): Digital experience resources and guides for Zero Trust analytics.

## Device monitoring

- [Device monitoring](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/monitoring/index.md): Device monitoring in Zero Trust analytics.

## Synthetic tests

- [Synthetic tests](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/tests/index.md): Synthetic tests resources and guides for Zero Trust analytics.
- [HTTP test](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/tests/http/index.md): Reference information for HTTP test in Zero Trust analytics.
- [Traceroute test](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/tests/traceroute/index.md): Reference information for Traceroute test in Zero Trust analytics.
- [View test results](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/tests/view-results/index.md): View test results in Zero Trust analytics.

## Rules

- [Rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/rules/index.md): Reference information for Rules in Zero Trust analytics.

## Diagnostics

- [Diagnostics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/diagnostics/index.md): Diagnostics tools for collecting captures, running speed tests, and troubleshooting device connectivity in Digital Experience Monitoring.
- [Client packet capture](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/diagnostics/client-packet-capture/index.md): Feature documentation for Cloudflare One client packet captures.
- [Speed test](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/diagnostics/speed-test/index.md): Run speed tests from the Cloudflare One client to measure network throughput, latency, and quality scores for end user devices.

- [Troubleshoot Digital Experience Monitoring](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/dex/troubleshooting/index.md): Resolve common issues with Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX), including data visibility problems and remote capture failures.
